poses.caption: Lower into a push-up with elbows close to the sides.
Press into a straight-arm high plank.
Support on the left hand and tap the left shoulder with the right hand.
Repeat the push-up, then support on the right hand and tap the right shoulder with the left hand.

jobs.detail: SHOULDER TAP PUSH-UP, FOUR equal SQUARE panels in 2x2. SAME FRONT three-quarter angle head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, chest visible, plain floor thin gray mat only. Knees always extended off floor, both toes grounded, straight head-shoulders-hips-heels, pelvis level. TOP LEFT lower: BOTH palms floor, elbows bent close sides, chest near floor. TOP RIGHT top: BOTH palms floor under shoulders, elbows straight, high plank. BOTTOM LEFT: high plank on LEFT palm directly under left shoulder, RIGHT hand crosses chest to TOUCH LEFT SHOULDER, right elbow lifted bent, both toes grounded. BOTTOM RIGHT: high plank on RIGHT palm under right shoulder, LEFT hand crosses chest to TOUCH RIGHT SHOULDER, left elbow lifted bent, both toes grounded. Clearly opposite shoulder taps, one floor supporting palm in each tap panel, no hand resting on same-side shoulder, no raised arm reaching ceiling, no bent knees. Same body/pelvis direction fixed through all phases, stable core no hip twist. Primary PECTORALS ONE smoothly blurred diffuse red teaching tint across front chest of intact black shirt, no muscle fibers/radial rays in garment. Exposed arm/calf grayscale fine detail, no bench.

poses.caption: Hold a forearm side plank with straight legs stacked and hips lifted.
Raise the straight top leg toward the ceiling, pause briefly, then lower with control; switch sides after the repetitions.

jobs.detail: FOREARM SIDE BRIDGE HIP ABDUCTION STAR, TWO equal SQUARE panels side by side same fixed FRONT-side three-quarter view. LEFT FOREARM grounded on gray mat with elbow directly under shoulder, forearm points ahead palm down, LEFT bottom leg STRAIGHT with outer left shoe on mat, pelvis raised in straight line head-shoulders-hips-bottom heel. RIGHT top hand rests on right hip. LEFT START: BOTH straight legs stacked, top right shoe resting on bottom left shoe, hold forearm side plank. RIGHT RAISE: keep exact bottom forearm/body/leg unchanged and hips lifted, raise RIGHT TOP LEG STRAIGHT upward away from bottom leg by about35degrees, right knee fully extended, toes forward, no hip flexion/knee tuck, no top arm raised. Bottom shoe remains grounded, top shoe clearly separated elevated, normal anatomical leg lengths/hip connections. Primary ABDUCTORS ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red patch over OUTER top hip/upper thigh on fully opaque black shorts, no rays/fibers/muscle divisions on fabric. No red abdomen/chest. Both legs/calves visible fine grayscale exposed anatomy. Full opaque shirt and shorts front sides back seat crotch; whole model inside generous margins.
